title: Otkrivanje, klasifikacija i IRM
summary: Data discovery za strukturirane, polustrukturirane i nestrukturirane podatke i lokaciju podataka, politike klasifikacije, data mapping, labeling i tagging, te Information Rights Management (prava, provisioning, modeli pristupa, PKI).
summary_en: Data discovery for structured, semi-structured, and unstructured data and data location, classification policies, data mapping, labeling and tagging, and Information Rights Management (rights, provisioning, access models, PKI).
